name: Sailing to Madagascar
summary: Sailors from the islands, whose language was closest to that of the Ma'anyan of southern Borneo, cross or skirt the Indian Ocean and settle Madagascar, 6,000 kilometres away. Malagasy is still an Austronesian language. How they went, and how many voyages it took, is unknown.

stops.note: The home of the language closest to Malagasy.
Out between Java and Sumatra into the Indian Ocean.
Perhaps by way of the African coast and the islands.
A new home across the ocean.
